limits: Native jobs, PID lifetimes and controller/bootstrap exits were measured; every target/approval fact was synthetic and each new VBox poweroff was replaced at the boundary with an isolated Python child. No selected VM operation or native-target owner activation ran.

Ready proves a particular original worker/lease handshake; it explicitly grants no VM-start permission. Actual boot admission must combine it with scoped target/start/backup/media/root approvals and independently validated current target state.

Process survival is measured for the named controller kill job and released/bootstrap process handles. Arbitrary ancestor jobs, Windows logoff/reboot, owner crash, system power loss and host kernel stalls remain unqualified.

Source reads, SQLite/fsync/native calls can stall under host failures; the loop and command checks are not a hard real-time external hypervisor deadman proof. Owner/host loss can leave target state unknown and requires independent reconciliation.

PID/image checks and same-user job separation do not authenticate code, approvals or observers against a hostile host. Host ACLs, executable/Python dependencies, session/service placement and authentic approval transport remain unqualified.

The provisional review starts the immutable lease; a slow review expires it rather than extending deadlines. Missing/altered/noncanonical approvals cannot resume that suspended worker. A fresh attempt needs a new directory/nonce; no takeover or automatic rearm exists.

The final fixture uses the generated bootstrap and real worker loop; test-only source installs the Python surrogate before entry. This does not qualify the real VBox command latency, cleanup or its complete target stop path.
Archived case directories contain copied evidence from temporary roots, expired synthetic leases and stale test PIDs/approvals. They are not runnable deployment packets and must not be replayed.
Original-stop revision 02 and transfer revision 03 were not changed. New owner launch revision 01 and host revision 05 remain unarmed; no source-cohort mixing or inferred native approval is allowed.
Guard creation, broker phase policy, same-boot review design, genuine backup/receipt issuers, guest hardening/install and M1-11 through M1-14/product lifecycle requirements remain incomplete.
next_check: Bind the owner-ready proof into actual boot/startup admission, including denial before readiness and failure handling. Keep all native target actions and pending architectural choices behind their separate explicit approvals.
